preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 1000 for N, P, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of students N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(N-1 <= P <= 100000 for N, P, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of connections P is between N-1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M <= 100000 for N, P, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries M is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and 1 <= d <= 1000000 for N, P, M, connections in test_cases for u, v, d in connections)
preconditions.description: For each connection in a test case, the computers u and v are between 1 and N inclusive, and the distance d is between 1 and 1000000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for N, P, M, connections, queries in test_cases for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query in a test case, the computers u and v are between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == 1 + M for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each test case's output consists of 1 line for the case number and M lines for the query results.

postconditions.expression: all(output[0] == f'Case: {i+1}' for i, output in enumerate(outputs))
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is 'Case: case_no' where case_no is the 1-based index of the test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result > 0 for output in outputs for result in output[1:])
postconditions.description: Each query result is a positive integer representing the minimum length of cable used to connect the queried computers.
